t.E153.agn: In 2012 EFSA did not set an ADI because data were limited; it saw no safety concern at the reported uses if residual PAHs (as benzo[a]pyrene) are below 1.0 µg/kg.
t.E153.body: Vegetable carbon is practically not absorbed from the gut.
t.E153.prod: Obtained by carbonising plant material such as wood.
t.E153.regx.0: No ADI set; no safety concern if PAH residues are below the limit.
t.E153.summary: Black carbon obtained by burning plant material. Used in black confectionery and cheese rinds.
